title: Don't Fake It If You Can't Make It: Driver Misconduct in Last-Mile Delivery
abstract: arXiv:2609.29080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the last two decades, last-mile delivery (LMD) firms have seen immense growth fueled by the success of e-commerce, leading to faster and cheaper deliveries. Operating on thin margins, LMD firms strive for successful first-time deliveries to avoid the financial and reputational costs of reattempts. Delivery Agents (DAs) are integral to LMD efficiency, influencing customer experience, delivery success, and productivity. However, most LMD performance enhancement research focuses on process, technology, and incentives, which presume workers will conform to procedures and monitoring tools will function flawlessly. Nevertheless, in practice, DAs deviate from expected behaviors, i.e., indulge in misconduct, negatively affecting delivery efficiency, often resulting in returned parcels. translated_title: 做不到就别造假：最后一公里配送中的司机不当行为
translated_abstract: 在过去二十年中，最后一公里配送（LMD）企业在电子商务成功的推动下实现了巨大增长，带来了更快、更廉价的配送服务。由于运营利润微薄，LMD企业力求首次配送成功，以避免二次配送带来的财务和声誉成本。配送员（DAs）是LMD效率不可或缺的组成部分，影响着客户体验、配送成功率和生产力。然而，大多数LMD绩效提升研究聚焦于流程、技术和激励机制，这些研究假设员工会遵守操作规程且监控工具能完美运行。但在实践中，配送员会偏离预期行为，即出现不当行为，对配送效率产生负面影响，常常导致包裹被退回。其中一种主要的不当行为是虚假备注配送，即配送员故意不投递包裹并提供虚假理由。例如，
tldr: 该论文揭示了最后一公里配送中被忽视的配送员不当行为问题（尤其是虚假备注配送），指出以往绩效提升研究关于员工遵守流程、监控工具完美运行的假设在实践中并不成立。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes driver misconduct—particularly fake remarked deliveries—in last-mile delivery, challenging the prevailing assumption that workers conform to procedures and monitoring tools function flawlessly in performance enhancement research.
